reviewer.name: blind_listener_f10
reviewer.role: retained original independent code-blind visual judge

scope: Bounded before/after pixels-only review of visible victory acknowledgement, reward receipt and separation from quick bindings. Independent new current rating; other rows and previous evidence are unchanged.

visible_context.before: H35 shows a nearly depleted Voltarach health bar; H36 shows an empty bar and fallen/lowered wild creature; H37/H38 explicitly say 'The wild creature is beaten.' and name a Hollows Alpha/Great Candy reward.
visible_context.after: Both supplied after views show a fallen blue creature, the 'The wild creature is beaten.' headline and an explicitly titled 'Victory rewards' card. This supports assessing the visible victory acknowledgement layout, without inferring its runtime cause.

before.reason: In H37/H38 the colored item icon, x1 and four white empty binding markers form one central row between the victory headline and the Great Candy acknowledgement sentence. Neither a labeled receipt container nor spatial separation distinguishes that row from the acknowledgement. The explicit victory wording is readable, but the five markers can be read as grouped earned reward tiles.

after.reason: Both after views place the reward acknowledgement inside a dark, gold-bordered card titled 'Victory rewards' at the upper right. The Hollows Alpha and Great Candy text wraps clearly and remains fully inside the card. The item icon/x1 and four empty binding markers sit together in a separate lower-right HUD area above exploration controls, with substantial space between them and the reward card. This makes the receipt and the quick-binding row visibly distinct.
bounded_positive_findings: Explicit receipt heading and enclosing border establish a coherent reward group.
Readable text identifies Great Candy and its stated recipient condition.
Four empty binding markers no longer occupy the space between the victory headline and its reward sentence.
Both supplied after views retain the same clear separation.
finish_limits: The receipt is textual; the pictured card does not itself display a dedicated item thumbnail or numeric quantity. That does not recreate the assessed binding/reward grouping defect.
No separate item-detail, long-reward-list or alternate-resolution receipt is supplied.

current_rating.severity_reason: The named grouping defect is not observed in the supplied after views. Severity 1 is the requested scale minimum, not a claim that an observed defect remains.
current_rating.exposure_reason: This is an episodic end-of-fight acknowledgement rather than continuously present combat UI; the receipt is prominent when shown.
current_rating.importance_reason: Players must distinguish rewards earned from existing quick bindings; reward comprehension is important to progression.
current_rating.independence: Current numeric values were assigned from these newly inspected pixels and the written UI/readability bar, without reading or transferring previous scores.

inspection.references: Previously inspected approved Stormwood boards and current written ART_DIRECTION UI/readability bar.
inspection.pixel_comparison: UI grouping/legibility comparison; no exact matched world pose or pixel-identical camera claim.

limitations: Only the supplied four before and two after full rasters were inspected for this task.

The screenshots support visible victory presentation and layout only; no earned combat, actual reward grant, inventory persistence, participant eligibility, result timing, dismissal or controller behavior is certified.
No motion, four-player, 7-inch physical display, other resolutions/presets, long reward lists or full visual matrix claim.
No judgement of other catalogue rows, loss presentation, bark, full F41 or whole release acceptance is made.
preservation: All original catalogue ratings, prior verdicts, receipts and witnesses remain unchanged. Only this new evidence artifact is written.
